Bachelor's Degree and 6 or more years of experience in the Risk Engineering area OR

Account Executive & Loss Control/Risk Engineering experience within the insurance industry
Certified Safety Professional (CSP) and/or Associate in Risk Management (ARM) designations a plus.

People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp casualty exposures and the logic of risk assessment work.
cond_0328.responsibilities:
Our Senior Risk Engineering Consultant is responsible for:
Managed account risk portfolio and provided account-level engineering to meet underwriting requirements. Developing and implementing customer service strategies that reduce loss and improve customer operations. Providing engineering support to the underwriting team by attending client broker meetings. Monitoring casualty account engineering services to ensure that delivery is proper, on time, and cost-effective. Perform casualty risk assessments or specific LOB exposure evaluations for prospects and existing customers within the [Location masked] region. Providing casualty consultative services to customers, including identifying exposures with significant loss potential, investigation of cause/effect of major losses, and management programs. Assisting in marketing [Company name masked] risk transfer insurance products in conjunction with underwriting professionals and agents across company business segments.
Final candidates will be subject to a Motor Vehicle Record background check as this position includes a company car.
cond_0328.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree and 6 or more years of experience in the Risk Engineering area OR
High School Diploma or Equivalent and 8 or more years of experience in the Risk Engineering area
Experience working in a team environment
Experience with assessing casualty exposures
Capable of managing and coordinating safety services for large customers with multiple locations
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Fire Science, Health and Safety, or related degree
Account Executive & Loss Control/Risk Engineering experience within the insurance industry
Certified Safety Professional (CSP) and/or Associate in Risk Management (ARM) designations
Knowledgeable in safety management programs that control workplace hazards, educate employees, and promote safety awareness/accountabilities
